sloka: मूलम् अर्थस्य संरक्ष्यम् एष कार्यविदाम् नयः ।मूले हि सति सिध्यन्ति गुणाः पुष्प फल उदयः ॥४-६५-२५॥
transliteration: mūlam arthasya saṁrakṣyam eṣa kāryavidām nayaḥ ।mūle hi sati sidhyanti guṇāḥ puṣpa phala udayaḥ ॥4-65-25॥

translations.english: 'The root of any objective should be protected well. This is the basis of an accomplisher. Only when the roots are intact, the trees have the ability to yield flowers and fruits.
